FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Title: Foundry Translate
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Menu.Name: Foundry Translate
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Menu.Label: Configure translator
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Menu.Hint: Configure a local or cloud translation provider and verify its availability.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Heading: Translator connection
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Intro: Choose free local translation in Chrome or a cloud provider for this world.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Name: Provider
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Hint: Choose a local or cloud translator.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Chro: Runs directly in desktop Chrome 138 or newer, with no API key and no character limit. Chromium forks such as Helium may not include the required language models.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.Provider.Goog: Uses the official Google Cloud Translation Basic v2 API and may incur charges.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.ApiKey.Name: Google Cloud API key
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.ApiKey.Hint: The key is stored only in this browser on this device.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.SourceLanguag: Keep automatic detection when an adventure combines multiple languages.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.PrivacyChrome: Translation runs locally in the GM browser. Text and names are not sent to Google or another translation service.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Settings.PrivacyGoogle: Requests are sent directly from the GM browser to Google Cloud. The API key is never stored in the world, compendium, or an export.

FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Menu.Name: Name glossary
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Menu.Label: Manage glossary
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Menu.Hint: Find character and location names and store them for safe translation.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Heading: Protected name glossary
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Intro: Names in the glossary remain exactly in their original language during translation.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.StorageHint: The glossary is stored in the Foundry Translate — Glossary world compendium inside the Foundry Translate folder. It stays on the server with the world.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.ManualHint: Add a name that must not be translated, or give it a fixed custom translation. Entering an existing term with a new translation updates it.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.ManualPlaceho: For example, Order of the Silver Dragon

FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Status.Added: The custom name was added to the glossary.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Status.Replac: The custom translation of the term was updated.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Status.Duplic: This name already exists in the glossary with the same translation.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.Glossary.Status.Error: The glossary could not be loaded.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Men: Safely store or update a translation of one world Journal Entry.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Int: Choose one world Journal Entry. The original remains unchanged and the stored translation opens directly.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Sou: The journal name, page names, and HTML text page contents will be translated.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Emp: There are no Journal Entries in this world
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Cop: One translation is stored per source journal and target language. It is updated when the source changes and never appears as a duplicate in the Journal sidebar.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Lim: The journal is processed one page at a time and long blocks are split safely. Markdown source is currently left unchanged.
FOUNDRY_TRANSLATE.JournalTranslation.Cac: Every completed page is written to the server cache. After an error, start again to resume safely.
